verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is entirely about AI/NPU/GPU software stack (ONNX, Vitis AI, Lemonade SDK, GAIA) and memory bandwidth for LLM inference; none of it addresses single-thread CPU performance or independent benchmark comparisons for everyday interactive responsiveness. Community comments even criticize benchmark methodology as 'terrible' without providing concrete single-thread figures, so there is no evidence the chip leads in single-thread benchmarks.
